map.灌溉水深 = 计划湿润层深度 × 土壤容重 × (上限含水率 − 下限含水率)；: Irrigation depth = planned wet-layer depth x soil bulk density x (upper - lower moisture); gross water = net water / irrigation efficiency; water cost = volume x unit price
map.按「计划湿润层深度 × 土壤类型持水参数 × 适宜含水量上下限差」估算一次灌水定: Estimate one irrigation quota by "planned wet-layer depth x soil-type water-holding parameter x suitable moisture range"; then by method (drip/sprinkler/flood) efficiency convert to gross water and estimate cost. Crop and soil types adjust demand and holding parameters, aiding water-saving comparisons.
